title: Watch the hands that build the machines
caption:
Boston Dynamics showed its Atlas factory floor, where teams build humanoid robots from custom parts to walking machines.

The factory machines parts in-house and handles assembly and repair under one roof.
Boston Dynamics says this setup gives them the speed to turn complex designs into walking hardware at scale.
